newsitem.title: USA: Regions Financial to buy New Iberia.
newsitem.headline: Regions Financial to buy New Iberia.

text.p: Regions Financial Corp said Friday it agreed to buy New Iberia Bancorp in a stock swap valued at about $65 million.
Under terms of the transaction, Regions will exchange 0.36 shares of its common stock for each New Iberia common share, Regions said.
Regions stock traded unchanged at 57-1/2 Friday, while New Iberia shares closed Thursday at 21. The shares' opening was delayed Friday.

New Iberia had $3.5 million for its fiscal 1996 year, Regions said. Regions did not say how much the acquisition would add to its own net, and officials there were not immediately available to comment further.
Regions said it expects to close the transaction in its third quarter of 1997, pending New Iberia shareholder and regulatory approval, as well as the completion of due diligence.
The transaction is expected to be a tax-free reorganization and to be accounted for as a pooling of interests, said Regions.
Regions also said it will issue about 1.1 million shares of its stock in the deal. It now has about 62.6 million shares outstanding.
